annotations.text: Direction B, picked 2026-09-06. The about card is cut from the same paper as the sheets: same rough border, 78 percent paper fill, shadow, and a -0.55 degree tilt. Words in [BRACKETS] are facts still to fill in: city, email, CV link. The portrait is a sketch placeholder in the icon style until there is a real drawing or photo.

One open decision. To keep the deck above a 900 px fold, the sheets lost 70 px and the spine titles dropped from 51 to 38 px, the site's own short-window size. The alternative keeps the 51 px titles and lets the deck run about 70 px past the fold. The spec lists both.
On a phone the card is full width and stacks above the sheets. Portrait 64 px beside the name, copy below, links in one row. The sheets keep their live phone layout.
The four directions from the first round, kept for reference. B was picked.
A. Margin note. Smallest footprint: 54 px. Trade-off: the name appears twice within 32 px.
C. Spec sheet. Two-line statement plus four numbered rows in the spine's label vocabulary. Trade-off: the facts sit at label size.
D. Statement. A 107 px headline; the deck becomes the second beat. Trade-off: the deck starts at 500 px.
